purpose: Stable GitHub-independent discovery catalog for the complete published Trinity Accord recovery set.

core_repository.resolution_rule: Resolve the concept DOI and select its latest published version.
core_repository.coverage_rule: Each version restores the exact immutable Git-tracked publication baseline named in its manifest; no version claims byte equality with a later moving GitHub main.

recovery_order: Resolve and restore the latest core repository version from concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21739343.
Verify the recovered preservation manifest and tracked-file inventory.
Verify Bitcoin Originals, authority manifests, signatures, digest manifests and corrections-index before making authority-level claims.
